subject: Splitting SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough into regional sessions — proposal
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Duarte <sofia.duarte@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: split SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough into regional 60-min sessions

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. You've got a few busy stakeholders across EU/US/APAC and mentioned calendars were tight. To make the walkthrough useful for each audience, would BlueHarbor be open to breaking the standard 90–120 min session into three focused 60-min regional sessions? Suggested scope:

- EU (controls + data residency / DPA follow-up) — Ops + Legal
- US (architecture + pen-test findings / patching cadence) — Infra + Sec
- APAC (SLA/ops runbook + SRE intake) — Support + CS

Pros: smaller attendee lists, more targeted evidence handoff, less cross-timezone friction. Con: slightly longer overall footprint but each meeting would be more actionable.

If that sounds OK, I can propose a few time slots (I included a quick Calendly poll here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/security-walkthrough-poll). Also attaching the current SOC2 evidence checklist and your draft SOW redlines so we can align.

Would love a quick note on whether you prefer 3 x 60m or a compressed 2 x 90m alternative.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (spreadsheet), BlueHarbor_SOW_redlines_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: Sofia Duarte <sofia.duarte@blueharbor.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Gareth Ellis <gareth.ellis@blueharbor.com>, procurement <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 13:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposal: split SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough into regional 60-min sessions

Hi Sergio —

Thanks — the 3x60m idea sounds sensible. A couple notes from our side:

- EU legal (my team) would prefer the EU session to include someone from your compliance/controls team since we're focused on DPA clauses and encryption-at-rest specifics.
- Gareth (copied) leads infra and wants the US session to include a short live demo of the KV cache behavior under sustained traffic (15 minutes max).
- Procurement flagged that they want any SOW changes reflected before we lock in dates — they may request a final redline pass.

We're available:
- EU: Thu 11/4 10:00–11:00 CET or Mon 11/8 14:00–15:00 CET
- US: Wed 11/10 09:00–10:00 PT or Fri 11/12 11:00–12:00 PT
- APAC: Tue 11/16 22:00–23:00 SGT (unfortunate, but our APAC SRE is only available then)

If you can confirm the Redwood attendees for each session (including a controls person and someone who can show the live demo), we can circulate invites.

Cheers,
Sofia
Head of Legal Operations
BlueHarbor Financial

Perfect — thanks for the availability.

Attendees from Redwood (tentative):

- US session: Ben Carter (Platform demo lead), one of our infra engs on standby for the KV cache demo

Sergio
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: split SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough into regional 60-min sessions

Hi all —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick read of the SOW redlines attached. Two items I want to call out before we accept:

1) Encryption-at-rest language (Section 4.2) — BlueHarbor's suggested phrasing requires customer-managed keys for backups. We support that but need to scope KMS integration costs in the SOW (I'd suggest an optional addendum).
2) Evidence delivery cadence — the proposed timeline expects daily exports for 30 days post-onboarding. That's heavier than our normal cadence; suggest 'weekly for first 30 days then monthly' unless they can clarify a specific audit window.

I'll draft counter-proposal sentences and include them below by EOD. Attaching a stripped-down evidence checklist (SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx) that maps controls to the expected artifact names.

Laura Bennett
Principal, Trust & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (updated mapping)

Procurement asked for a DocuSign-ready SOW with your counter language inserted where you propose addenda. If you can provide that (we can click through), procurement will route the SOW for signature.

If you confirm the 90m + 60m plan, we'll lock the following:
- EU+US (combined): Tue 11/9 09:00–10:30 UTC
- APAC: Tue 11/16 22:00–23:00 SGT

Thanks,
